one_line: Lay out the whole product on a table, then one short top-down shot per step with a text label.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wide handheld night shot: a girl dances, a teen holds the product box, before a projector screen, a neon sign and striped popcorn boxes. No Hebrew line. English text builds from "Movie" to "Movie time" by 0:01.
q1_hook.why: A lit-up party scene shows the end result first, with the box in hand (H1, S1). The English headline names the topic but not the benefit (T3, H2). There is no Hebrew voice or line in the first 6 s (H4, H6), and the dark wide frame makes the box small (F4).

beats.what: Night party scene: two girls dance with the box before a projector screen; "Movie time"
Hands slide pink striped branded popcorn boxes in front of the screen
beats.why: A close look at the branded pieces

beats.what: Girl about 10 to 12 behind a kitchen table with the pack laid out, talking to the lens
beats.why: Names the product, the need and the ease

beats.what: Top-down hands: 3 spoons of corn, purple lid, into the microwave
beats.why: Short steps with a text label each

beats.what: She leans to the container: "וואי איזה ריח"
beats.why: A real reaction at the popcorn

beats.what: Freezer packs go in, "לאחר 8 שעות במקפיא"; pour the drink; she lifts the cup
Three children on an outdoor couch at night hold boxes and a drink to the lens, then eat
beats.why: Family delight, the reason to buy

beats.what: Push-in on the party set with "MOVIE FUN PACK"

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked. The spoken closer "ועכשיו נשאר לכם רק לבחור סרט" invites a choice but not a reply. Caption only says where to find the product. No question, save or share ask.
q2_flow.why: Result first, then how-to, then payoff is an easy arc (K2, R4), and steps of 1 to 3 s keep the middle moving (R3, E2). The 10 s talking block at 0:06 is the one static stretch, and value is clear only at 0:12 (H2, R1). It stops soon after the payoff (E8).

q3_cta.what: Spoken and subtitled 0:32 to 0:35: "ועכשיו נשאר לכם רק לבחור סרט", "תהנו". Text 0:39 to 0:42: "MOVIE FUN PACK". Caption last line: "תוכלו למצוא את המוצר אצל @palphot". No link, comment word or price.
q3_cta.why: One soft action, in the caption only, so it stays clear of bait (C1, C2). It names a retailer but gives no link or price, and the first caption lines say nothing about it (C6). The English product-name card sits in the bottom band for about 3 s (C7, T4).

q4_shown.what: The box in hand at a night party at 0:00; the whole pack laid out on a kitchen table 0:06 to 0:16; two sets of steps in close-up (popcorn, then freezer packs and drink); three children with popcorn and a drink at 0:32. No price.
q4_shown.why: Laying out every part first shows what comes in the box (H2), and the steps prove it is easy (R3). A kid presenter vouches with a smell reaction (S6), and children's smiles close it (K8). The product stays on screen throughout (H3). Children's faces are what LumeBook's Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 17 shots in 43 s (first pass), about 2.5 s each: a 10 s talking shot, then hard cuts through 1 to 3 s close-up steps. No speed changes seen. Ends on a push-in with sparkle effect and a text card.
q5_edit.why: The talking shot is the only long hold, and the short steps move fast (E2, R3). Short subtitles in the top band sit clear of the buttons (E4, T4). The sparkle and push-in on the last shot add a polished, ad-like finish (E6).

q6_topic.what: A kid recommends a popcorn-and-drink kit for family movie night, with easy steps. It serves parents looking for a family evening idea.
q6_topic.why: A shared family evening ends in delight (K1, K6), and the steps are practical but sit inside a feeling (K4). It is not tied to a gift or a milestone, so no buying moment is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Wide handheld night shots with neon and a projector, dark and grainy; a static medium kitchen shot in bright even light; top-down hands steps in daylight; handheld couch shots lit by the screen. A girl about 10 to 12 speaks to the lens.
q7_filmed.why: The kitchen shot is bright, steady and eye to eye (F6, F7), and the top-down hands are easy to follow (F5). The night shots are dark and the product small in the wide frame (F7, F4), and the neon set looks styled like an ad (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: English headline "Movie time" (white bold, pink outline, about 60% down, 0:00 to 0:03). Then thin white Hebrew subtitles in the top band: 0:06 "כמשפחה מה שאנחנו הכי אוהבים לעשות זה לצפות בסרט יחד", 0:17 "שמים 3 כפות תירס לפופקורן", 0:27 "לאחר 8 שעות במקפיא", 0:32 "ועכשיו נשאר לכם רק לבחור סרט". 0:39 English "MOVIE FUN PACK" in the bottom band.
q8_text.caption: "קבלו מוצר מושלם שמשדרג את חווית הסרט המשפחתית". About 53 words: product pitch, a contents list with emoji, "תוכלו למצוא את המוצר אצל @palphot". No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Short step labels in the top band suit sound off and stay clear of the buttons (T1, T2, T4). The first headline is English and states a topic, not a promise (T3). The caption names the contents in searchable words but has no hashtags and no disclosure (T7, T8).

weak_points: No Hebrew line in the first 6 s, English headline; value clear only at 0:12; a staged neon party a solo creator cannot copy; product-name card in the bottom band; no price or link.
lumebook_takeaway: Lay the book and its box on a table in one steady shot, then film each step top-down, hands only, with a short label.
not_verified: Whether the presenter is the account owner or a family child; the role of omer_mahtzri; whether palphot is a shop or a brand; the audio of the first 6 s (garbled English-like words, probably a song); who the other children are. Cut count from the first pass. Small correction to src/coded: the headline builds from "Movie" at 0:00 to "Movie time" at 0:01.
